note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the abwildfire-build-001 worker artifact c2c8ceb56c7ff52aaf748473e1251725c4ee86912edb9b17387e6b44d0e43da2 (gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact on the worker, failed_checks empty, exact-byte --accept on the worker and re-accept in abwildfire-baseline-002 before any score); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the worker pipeline, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the benchmark's verbatim runner files plus the reproduce script. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The prediction instant is the publisher's own initial-assessment timestamp (assessment_datetime, 'originally assessed by Alberta Wildfire employees'; read as America/Edmonton local operational time, confirmed against the official 2016 Horse River review): every shipped feature is the crew-observed assessment record (assessment_hectares, fire_spread_rate, fire_type, fire_position_on_slope, the in-situ weather block, fuel_type), a pre-instant timing field (elapsed hours from reported/discovered/estimated start, detection channel) or calendar/geography, and the label (final area burned >= 100 ha from current_size) lies entirely after the instant. The label sources (current_size, size_class, first_uc_date) are excluded from every shipped column, as are every post-instant family (cause, dispatch, suppression milestones, fire name/origin, discovered size) with measured ordering evidence (dispatch_date after assessment for 2.41% of rows). Population: ALL assessed FPA wildfires 2006-2025 (27,828; eligibility assessment-based, no outcome-conditioned rule; winter rows kept and counted). Splits by the assessment instant's calendar year: train 2006-2015 (15,864 rows / 297 positives / 156 distinct positive dates), eval 2016-2020 (5,707 / 104 / 79), holdout 2021-2025 (6,257 / 257 / 128, sealed; the higher rate is the documented 2023 record season - recorded non-stationarity). The archive is ONE current compilation (portal updated 2026-02-17; no historical per-fire vintages; in-place revision of area, cause and location documented by the publisher, aggregate 2019 revision measured at -10.4%; 89 fires within +-20% of the threshold bound the label-flip exposure), so the evaluation contract is retrospective research: use retrospective_research, access isolated_rows, training_label_timing unverified, no operational as-of claim. MEASURED COMPARISONS (the deciding check is part of the artifact's record, pre-registered before any score): construction-time triad on the identical 5,707 eval rows - persistence (assessment_hectares) 0.9096, calendar/identity prior 0.7130, simple full-feature L2 logistic 0.9206, majority-class accuracy 0.9818, full-minus-persistence +0.0111 day-cluster CI [-0.0292, +0.0514] INCONCLUSIVE (interval contains zero; not parity); the runner-contract baseline (abwildfire-baseline-002) is recorded beside them in measurements.json with its own deciding verdict under the same pre-registered rule. No figure may be quoted without the comparison. The 42.0% already-controlled-at-assessment stratum makes the secondary containment formulation a separate possible task instance, deliberately not shipped.
